days.top_line: Oil stayed above **$106** as Iran and the US resumed **Qatar-mediated shuttle talks** over Hormuz today, while a seventh straight weak week left the Sensex near six-month lows.
Sunday was tense: UK police foiled a bomb plot near a base used in US strikes on Iran. Kohli passed 15,000 ODI runs, and Anthropic claimed major AI science breakthroughs.
